name: Skogskyrkogården
description: Skogskyrkogården, "the Woodland Cemetery," lies in Gamla Enskede on the southern edge of Stockholm. Architects Gunnar Asplund and Sigurd Lewerentz began it in 1917 in old gravel pits dotted with pines, shaping graves, chapels and gentle slopes around the natural dips and hills. Visitors walk through quiet forest and open meadow, and its landscape has inspired cemetery design around the world.
